videoDetails.title: Destiny 2 - Izanagi's Burden - Audiovisual Showcase (Exotic Sniper Rifle) | Black Armory
videoDetails.shortDescription:
An in-depth audiovisual showcase of 'Izanagi's Burden', an Exotic Sniper Rifle from Destiny 2. This video is all about the weapon animations, sounds and the visual effects (vfx). Everything is shown in slow-motion as well; for a more detailed look and greater appreciation of the work put into this weapon.

Izanagi's Burden was added to Destiny 2: Forsaken during Year 2 (Season 5) of the game with the Black Armory update (Season of the Forge). It is a Kinetic weapon that uses Special ammo, has a fire-rate of 90 rounds per minute and a magazine size of 4.

The Exotic Perks of this weapon are:
Honed Edge: Consume the magazine and load a round with additional range and damage.
No Distractions: Aiming this weapon for a short period reduces flinch.

Timestamps:
0:00 Weapon model, description & stats
0:03 Standard fire from the hip
0:17 Weapon reload
0:21 Fire & reload (slow-motion)
0:32 Rapid-fire (hip)
0:38 Honed Edge (Consume the magazine for 1 powerful round)
0:48 Honed Edge (slow-motion)
1:01 ADS (Aim Down Sights)
1:18 Rapid-fire (ADS)
1:26 Honed Edge (ADS)
1:36 Gameplay
1:48 Weapon reticles (Normal, Honed Edge & Empty)
1:54 Honed Edge vfx (turning it on and off)
2:07 Honed Edge vfx & sound (slow-motion)
2:13 Weapon holstered
2:17 Ultraclocked reload
